rules.statement: An administrator in possession of property belonging to the deceased's estate owes an equal duty by virtue of his office to all the intestate heirs without discrimination, and, so long as that fiduciary relationship subsists, the law will not permit him to say that he held the property for the benefit only of those to whom he was bound by special ties of kinship or affection.
